description: Generate a repo insight report by combining doc/code search and usage links.

functions.name: analyze_repo
functions.summary: Search docs and code graph for insights, then store a summary.

params.name: query
params.description: What to learn about the repository.

params.name: note_key
params.description: Memory key to store the summary.

params.name: write_report
params.description: Whether to write the report to disk.

returns.description: Summary, memory key, and optional report path.

examples.title: Summarize routing docs
examples.code:
import skills

async def main():
    result = await skills.load("repo-insight").analyze_repo(
        query="Next.js routing docs summary",
        output_dir="output/reports",
        note_key="routing_docs_summary",
        write_report=True,
    )
    return result
